To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a 4D EM direct reconstruction algorithm for plasma or reference-tissue input model was developed for reversible tracers; (ii) the algorithm was generalized to incorporate prior information about the bounds on image values; (iii) the generalized 4D ABEM method resulted in improved accuracy of DV and DVR estimates, as demonstrated in a mathematical phantom study and a patient study.

(1) direct parametric image reconstruction can be performed for linearized models (i.e. graphical analysis) of reversibly binding tractors using a 4D AB EM reconstruction algorithm; (2) such direct parametric reconstruction can lead to notable improvements in quantitative accuracy; and (3) the use of spatial prior information in the form of lower bounds can lead to further improvements in quantitative accuracy.
A direct 4D ABEM reconstruction scheme has been developed to directly reconstruct DV and DVR parametric images from dynamic PET data.
